commands.name: lint
commands.run: bun install --frozen-lockfile && SKIP_ENV_VALIDATION=true bun run lint && SKIP_ENV_VALIDATION=true bun run check:boundaries

commands.name: typecheck
commands.run: bun install --frozen-lockfile && SKIP_ENV_VALIDATION=true bun run typecheck:app

commands.name: test
commands.run: bun install --frozen-lockfile && SKIP_ENV_VALIDATION=true bun run test:web:integration

setup.name: bun
setup.command: command -v bun >/dev/null && [ "$(bun --version)" = 1.3.14 ] || { curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash -s bun-v1.3.14 && sudo ln -sf $HOME/.bun/bin/bun /usr/local/bin/bun && sudo ln -sf $HOME/.bun/bin/bun /usr/local/bin/bunx; }

setup.name: node
setup.command: command -v node >/dev/null || { curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_24.x | sudo -E bash - && sudo apt-get install -y nodejs; }
